# dagsterplus_deployment (Resource)

Manages a Dagster+ deployment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dagsterplus_deployment" "prod" {
  name = "prod"
  type = "SERVERLESS"
}

resource "dagsterplus_deployment" "hybrid" {
  name = "hybrid-prod"
  type = "HYBRID"
}

output "prod_deployment_id" {
  value = dagsterplus_deployment.prod.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the deployment. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Deployment identifier (same as name).
- `status` (String) The current status of the deployment (e.g. ACTIVE, PENDING_DELETION).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Deployments are imported using the deployment name (which is also the ID).
terraform import dagsterplus_deployment.example prod
```
